events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, commenced on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite moment from Woodstock '69?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: We remember the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. His music continues to move generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the day hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years on, Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains undeniable. His lyrics still resonate deeply.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: We remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to Jimi Hendrix, a true pioneer whose revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Across The Zebra Crossing
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From that legendary cover to the incredible tracklist, it's an album that stands the test of time.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude have fronted The Pretenders for decades.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid Turns 54
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The definitive frontman of a generation. What's your favourite Oasis or Liam solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine All The People
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an album that continues to inspire. Its title track remains a powerful anthem for peace and unity.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full Of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007? Let us know your top Bond film!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is truly timeless.

events.title: 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showcased their incredible versatility. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering A Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to shine brightly.
